definitions.gloss: desperate, strenuous, with all one's might
definitions.explanation: Putting maximum effort into something; trying one's hardest.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}に{働|はたら}いて{家族|かぞく}を{養|やしな}っている。
examples.english: I work hard to support my family.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一生|いっしょう}{懸命|けんめい}{勉強|べんきょう}した。
examples.english: He studied with all his might.

examples.japanese: {懸命|けんめい}な{努力|どりょく}が{実|みの}った。

notes:
{懸命|けんめい} means putting all one's effort into something.

Key expression:
- {一生|いっしょう}{懸命|けんめい} (with all one's might, desperately)
  - Very common set phrase
  - Originally {一所|いっしょ}{懸命|けんめい} (staking one's life on one place/position)

Common collocations:
- {懸命|けんめい}に{働|はたら}く (to work desperately hard)
- {懸命|けんめい}な{努力|どりょく} (strenuous efforts)
- {懸命|けんめい}に{訴|うった}える (to appeal desperately)

Related terms:
- {必死|ひっし} (desperate, frantic)
- {全力|ぜんりょく} (full power, with all one's strength)
- {熱心|ねっしん} (eager, enthusiastic)
